strings.name: Jeff Bezos
strings.summary: Jeff Bezos built Amazon from an online bookstore into a retail, logistics and cloud-services business. He also founded Blue Origin, bought The Washington Post and established the Earth Fund. In 2021 he became Amazon’s executive chair, devoting more attention to other ventures.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2025, not an exhaustive news record. Institutional achievements are team efforts; announced plans are not completed results.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Amazon and Blue Origin, influencing e-commerce, cloud infrastructure and commercial spaceflight.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Princeton University, bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and computer science, 1986
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Retail and cloud services
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Amazon expanded under his leadership from bookselling into broad retail and AWS cloud services.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Space and climate investment
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Founded Blue Origin and supported climate and conservation programs through the Earth Fund.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: New Glenn reached orbit
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Blue Origin’s heavy rocket reached its intended orbit on debut; booster recovery failed.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: New Shepard flight
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Joined Blue Origin’s first crewed suborbital flight.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Became executive chair
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Ended his CEO tenure; Andy Jassy succeeded him.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Established the Earth Fund
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Announced a US$10 billion commitment to climate action and nature protection.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Bought The Washington Post
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Purchased the newspaper personally, separately from Amazon.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: AWS infrastructure services
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Amazon launched S3 and EC2, developing a new infrastructure-services business.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Founded Blue Origin
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Established the aerospace company to develop lower-cost space transportation.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Founded Amazon
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Established the Seattle-area company, initially focused on selling books online.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Graduated from Princeton
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Completed electrical engineering and computer science studies before entering finance and technology.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Albuquerque
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born in New Mexico and later raised in Houston and Miami.
